en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a small Nordic town square with early 20th‑century cars and a bus parked in front of wooden and brick buildings. One brick building has a decorative gable and balcony with flower boxes; a ground‑floor window bears the name of a bank. The image title and location are printed in the lower left corner, and a small publisher's logo with the number 107 appears in the lower right.
